extracted.intended_audience: mathematicians preparing manuscripts for submission to Compositio Mathematica (journal authors)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for authors preparing and submitting research or review manuscripts to the journal Compositio Mathematica, including scope, required standards, and submission-system requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Journal scope (mainstream pure mathematics)
rubrics_metrics.description: Compositio Mathematica is a prestigious, well-established journal publishing first-class research papers that traditionally focus on the mainstream of pure mathematics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The journal has a broad scope which includes the fields of algebra, number theory, topology, algebraic and analytic geometry and global analysis. Papers on other topics are welcome only if they are of broad interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: High standards of quality and originality
rubrics_metrics.description: All contributions are required to meet high standards of quality and originality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions should be first-class research papers; the journal seeks original work of high quality and will assess manuscripts accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article types accepted
rubrics_metrics.description: The journal accepts specific article types such as Research Article and Review Article (among others listed on the site).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For the purposes of Gold Open Access funding, certain article types (e.g., Research Articles and Review Articles) are considered research articles. Certain article types may be eligible for APC waivers or discounts under agreements held by Cambridge University Press.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission system account and preparation
rubrics_metrics.description: Manuscripts must be submitted through a partner secure submission system which requires a separate account (distinct from Cambridge Core account).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should create an account on the submission system, consult the submission and support pages for login/submission help, and review the journal's author instructions—particularly the 'preparing your materials' page—before proceeding to the submission system.
